replacements.new:
# Keep one TLS ABI across the bootstrap and the Android 9 Bionic CI runtime.
	# API 29 remains the compile baseline; Clang emutls also works on API 29+.
	CFLAGS+=" -femulated-tls"
	export CXXFLAGS="$CFLAGS"

replacements.old:
# for manpage build
	local docbook_xsl_version=$(. $TERMUX_SCRIPTDIR/packages/docbook-xsl/build.sh; echo $TERMUX_PKG_VERSION)
	TERMUX_PKG_EXTRA_CONFIGURE_ARGS+=" -DDOCBOOK_XSL=$TERMUX_PREFIX/share/xml/docbook/xsl-stylesheets-$docbook_xsl_version-nons"
replacements.new:
# This bootstrap does not build documentation or the repository archiver.
	python3 - "$TERMUX_PKG_SRCDIR/CMakeLists.txt" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
path = Path(sys.argv[1])
text = path.read_text()
for old, new in (("find_package(Berkeley REQUIRED)", "set(BERKELEY_FOUND FALSE)"),
                 ("add_subdirectory(ftparchive)", "# AGENTCODI: no repository archiver")):
    if text.count(old) != 1:
        raise SystemExit("APT bootstrap CMake context mismatch: " + old)
    text = text.replace(old, new)
path.write_text(text)
PY

replacements.old: # Dependencies should be used from repo only if they are built for
replacements.new:
# AGENTCODI: every dependency is rebuilt for this prefix; no binary repo seeds.
if [[ "${TERMUX_INSTALL_DEPS-false}" == "true" || "${TERMUX_PACKAGE_LIBRARY-bionic}" != "bionic" || "${TERMUX_PACKAGE_FORMAT-debian}" != "debian" || "${TERMUX_ARCH-aarch64}" != "aarch64" || "${TERMUX_PKG_API_LEVEL-29}" != "29" ]]; then
	termux_error_exit "AGENTCODI requires source-built aarch64/Bionic/API 29 Debian packages; dependency downloads are disabled"
fi

# Dependencies should be used from repo only if they are built for

export TERMUX_SCRIPTDIR
# AGENTCODI: pin the target and reproducible timestamp for recursive builds too.
source "$TERMUX_SCRIPTDIR/agentcodi.env"

# Store pid

case "$TERMUX_PKG_NAME" in
		termux-core|termux-exec|termux-tools|termux-api|termux-keyring|root-repo|x11-repo) termux_error_exit "Package $TERMUX_PKG_NAME requires a separate AGENTCODI adaptation";;
	esac
	# shellcheck source=/dev/null
	source "$TERMUX_PKG_BUILDER_SCRIPT"

bin/dpkg-scansources
bin/dpkg-scanpackages
bin/dpkg-buildapi
bin/dpkg-buildtree
bin/dpkg-fsys-usrunmess
share/man/man1/dpkg-buildapi.*
share/man/man1/dpkg-buildtree.*
share/man/man1/dpkg-fsys-usrunmess.*
share/perl5
share/man/man1/dpkg-scanpackages.*
bin/dpkg-shlibdeps

if [[ -n "${TERMUX_PKG_GIT_COMMIT-}" && "$(git -C "$TMP_CHECKOUT" rev-parse HEAD)" != "$TERMUX_PKG_GIT_COMMIT" ]]; then
		termux_error_exit "Pinned package Git source mismatch"
	fi
	rm -rf "$TERMUX_PKG_SRCDIR"
	cp -rf "$TMP_CHECKOUT" "$TERMUX_PKG_SRCDIR"

replacements.old: TERMUX_PKG_DEPENDS="libassuan, libbz2, libgcrypt, libgnutls, libgpg-error, libksba, libnpth, libsqlite, readline, pinentry, resolv-conf, zlib"
replacements.new:
TERMUX_PKG_DEPENDS="libassuan, libbz2, libgcrypt, libgpg-error, libnpth, zlib"
# configure requires the X.509 headers; the gpgv target does not link libksba.
TERMUX_PKG_BUILD_DEPENDS="libksba"
: # The bootstrap variant installs only the signature verifier.

replacements.old:
# Build java keystore which is split out into a ca-certificates-java subpackage:
	local KEYUTIL_JAR=$TERMUX_PKG_CACHEDIR/keyutil-0.4.0.jar
	termux_download \
		https://github.com/use-sparingly/keyutil/releases/download/0.4.0/keyutil-0.4.0.jar \
		$KEYUTIL_JAR \
		18f1d2c82839d84949b1ad015343c509e81ef678c24db6112acc6c0761314610

	local JAVA_KEYSTORE_DIR=$TERMUX_PREFIX/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk/lib/security
	mkdir -p $JAVA_KEYSTORE_DIR

	java -jar $KEYUTIL_JAR \
		--import \
		--new-keystore $JAVA_KEYSTORE_DIR/jssecacerts \
		--password changeit \
		--force-new-overwrite \
		--import-pem-file $CERTFILE

replacements.new:
# Build the host ASN.1 generator from the same checksum-pinned source.
	local version url digest
	version=$(. "$TERMUX_SCRIPTDIR/packages/libtasn1/build.sh"; echo "$TERMUX_PKG_VERSION")
	url=$(. "$TERMUX_SCRIPTDIR/packages/libtasn1/build.sh"; echo "$TERMUX_PKG_SRCURL")
	digest=$(. "$TERMUX_SCRIPTDIR/packages/libtasn1/build.sh"; echo "$TERMUX_PKG_SHA256")
	termux_download "$url" "$TERMUX_PKG_CACHEDIR/host-libtasn1.tar.gz" "$digest"
	tar xf "$TERMUX_PKG_CACHEDIR/host-libtasn1.tar.gz"
	cd "libtasn1-$version"
	./configure --prefix="$TERMUX_PKG_HOSTBUILD_DIR/native" --disable-shared --enable-static --disable-doc
	make -j"$TERMUX_PKG_MAKE_PROCESSES"
	make install

# Preserve the edition TLS and hardening flags, including in libsepol.
CFLAGS += -DNO_PERSISTENTLY_STORED_PATTERNS

$TERMUX_PKG_SRCURL .
	# Pin this custom clone too; it bypasses the common Git-source hook.
	test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 1cbcdf624c248c66cd6153311d3e681ba1f9ff2a || termux_error_exit "Pinned libandroid-selinux source mismatch"
	cp -f

source "$subpackage"

		# AGENTCODI: executable subpackages retain their parent's original legal files.
		case "$SUB_PKG_NAME" in
			bzip2|gpgv|xz-utils)
				parent_legal="share/doc/$TERMUX_PKG_NAME"
				test -d "$parent_legal" || termux_error_exit "Missing parent legal material: $TERMUX_PKG_NAME"
				mkdir -p "share/doc/$SUB_PKG_NAME"
				cp -a "$parent_legal/." "share/doc/$SUB_PKG_NAME/"
				TERMUX_SUBPKG_INCLUDE+=" share/doc/$SUB_PKG_NAME/"
				;;
		esac
